data: Apple's fiscal 2025, which ended September 27, 2025, produced revenue of about $416.2 billion. Amazon's fiscal 2025 (calendar year 2025) revenue is harder to pin down. Summing its reported quarters gives roughly $713 billion, based on $155.7 billion in Q1, $167.7 billion in Q2, $180.2 billion in Q3, and an estimated Q4 near $209 billion. That makes Amazon about 1.7 times the size of Apple by revenue. Because I'm estimating Amazon's Q4 and can't confirm its audited full-year total, please check the figure against Amazon's fiscal 2025 Form 10-K before relying on the ratio.
